text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**Reps got time back.** Admin after visits dropped from roughly 45 minutes a day to under 15.

**CRM data improved.** Next steps and decision-makers were actually logged, because the summary did the typing.

**Trust took work.** Reps worried recordings would be used to police them. We said clearly: coaching only, never scorekeeping.

**Customers mostly said yes,** but asking first mattered more than the tool.

**Adoption followed the managers.** Teams whose leads reviewed summaries in pipeline meetings stuck with it.

The takeaway: the tech was the easy part. Clear rules and manager habits decided the outcome.

What would you want to know before piloting?
